The exact original induced module and action, torsion freeness, determinant twist, finite free bounded stages and degree bound deg(P) <= max(0, sum(lambda)+n*d) are proved. An infinite-order scalar is constructed from 2 or 3 in the original characteristic-zero local ring, so the final degree consumer has no scalar witness input. The adapted generic determinant is now proved irreducible over domains and prime over UFDs, including the source PID; the numerator-divisibility consumer remains to be proved. Integral highest-weight identification, embedding tensor products, nonzero localized Hecke/Galois realization, crystalline/Selmer dimensions, R=T and source automorphy continuation remain open.
